chosen.premise: Repeated kicking makes both of Hitmonlee’s legs stretch even farther, specifically to catch fleeing foes.
chosen.hook: Running away from Hitmonlee may make its kicks reach you faster.
chosen.visualIdea: A fleeing target gains distance, but every successive kick extends farther until it connects.
chosen.note: The strongest contradiction and hook: escaping causes repeated kicks to gain reach. Both cited entries directly support it.

candidates.premise: The faster Hitmonlee needs to move, the progressively longer its legs become, creating smooth, loping strides.
candidates.hook: For Hitmonlee, being in a hurry makes its legs grow.
candidates.visualIdea: Animate Hitmonlee rushing forward while each stride makes its legs visibly longer.
candidates.note: The unusual cause-and-effect is memorable and explicitly supported by multiple entries.

candidates.premise: Hitmonlee’s legs can stretch to twice their length, startling opponents with a reach they never expected.
candidates.hook: Hitmonlee can literally double the length of its legs.
candidates.visualIdea: Show normal legs extending to double length as an opponent realizes Hitmonlee can kick from far away.
candidates.note: A highly Hitmonlee-specific ability with direct Pokédex support; the double-length reveal is immediately visual.

candidates.premise: When Hitmonlee kicks, the sole of its foot becomes as hard as diamond at the exact moment of impact.
candidates.hook: Hitmonlee’s foot turns diamond-hard only when it hits.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom into the sole during a kick, transforming it into a diamond just before impact.
candidates.note: Very visual and well supported, though 'diamond-hard at the exact moment of impact' slightly sharpens the wording beyond the entries.

candidates.premise: Hitmonlee’s balance lets it deliver successive kicks from any position, not just while standing normally.
candidates.hook: Hitmonlee can keep kicking from basically any position.
candidates.visualIdea: Show a rapid sequence of kicks from upright, crouched, tilted, and airborne positions without losing balance.
candidates.note: Directly supported and easy to animate, but 'any position' is broad and less inherently dramatic than the stretching-leg mechanics.

candidates.premise: At level 20, Tyrogue can become Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, or Hitmontop—but only one becomes the Kick Master.
candidates.hook: Level 20 gives Tyrogue three fighting futures—and one is all legs.
candidates.visualIdea: As Tyrogue reaches level 20, split the screen into its three possible evolutions before spotlighting Hitmonlee.
candidates.note: The three-way evolution is visual, but the level-20 framing omits the actual evolution condition and the premise is partly about Tyrogue rather than Hitmonlee.

rounds.request: No stronger angle is needed; the chosen angle has the clearest concrete rule, strongest surprise, and most direct visual payoff.
